{{nihongo|'''Kataoka Shrine'''|片岡神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|fr|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|simple|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社|qid=Q9610964}}), and its former rank was {{ill|Q712534|lt=gōsha}}.

=== History ===
=== Outline ===
It is said that in ancient times it stood at the locale of Ōmine in Honmachi, {{ill|Ōji, Nara|ar|أوجي|arz|اوجى|ca|Ōji|ceb|Ōji-chō|es|Ōji (Nara)|fa|اوجی، نارا|fi|Ōji|fr|Ōji|hy|Օձի|it|Ōji (Giappone)|ja|王寺町|ko|오지정|ms|Ōji, Nara|my|အိုးဂျိမြို့၊ နာရ|pl|Ōji|ru|Одзи|sv|Ōji|tl|Oji, Nara|tr|Ōji|uk|Одзі (Нара)|ur|اوجی، نارا|zh|王寺町|qid=Q1346392}}. In {{ill|Daidō|Q1373191|qid=Q1373191|lt=Daidō}} 1 ({{ill|806|Q30021|qid=Q30021}}), it was allotted {{ill|Shinpo|Q1689534|qid=Q1689534}} of 7 households in Yamato, 8 in Tōtōmi, and 25 in Ōmi ({{ill|Shinshō Kyakuchokufushō|Q11502312|qid=Q11502312}}), and in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} it was ranked as a {{ill|Myōjin Taisha|fr|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|simple|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社|qid=Q9610964}}, a noted shrine included in rain-prayer rites.

In {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), in April, it was ranked as {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== Divine rank ===
*{{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611|lt=Ten'an}} 3 ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}), {{ill|January 27|Q2284|qid=Q2284}}: promoted from Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade, Merit Rank 8 to Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade, Merit Rank 8 (''{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|cs|Nihon Sandai Džicuroku|de|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|es|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fa|نیهون ساندای جیتسوروکو|ff|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fr|Nihon sandai jitsuroku|it|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ja|日本三代実録|ko|일본삼대실록|pt|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ru|Нихон сандай дзицуроку|simple|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|zh|日本三代實錄|zh_classical|日本三代實錄|qid=Q1052981}}'')

=== Access ===
* 15 minutes on foot from {{ill|Ōji Station (Nara)|Q856582|qid=Q856582}} on the {{ill|Yamatoji Line|Q1151659|qid=Q1151659}} and {{ill|Wakayama Line|Q511543|qid=Q511543}} of {{ill|West Japan Railway Company|Q502125|qid=Q502125}}
